text:
Alex Kim: quick UX q — how do we show automatic fallback triggers in Console audit? two directions: compact operator rows vs full event drilldown. thoughts?

Nora Patel: i'd like both. friendly mapped reasons (e.g., backend-unavailable) but also raw codes + counts. short list by default, expand for details. :eyes:

Chris Wang: agree. compact row should have: [mode] [trigger summary] [last seen] [sample rate] [short rationale]. click to expand into sampled events. ops folks often want quick context then raw evidence.

Maria Gomez: important: surface sampling fraction + which requests were sampled. otherwise folks think audit is making up numbers. show "sampled 1.0% (12 of 1200)" and link to sample ids.

Alex Kim: ops-bot posted earlier when r-20260323-14 tripped: that payload is the kind of thing we want surfaced. we must redact payloads by default. show path + status + stable event hash.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout r-20260323-14 triggered automatic fallback -> mode: soft_degrade, reason_summary: 503 spike, sampled: 12/1200, operator: Chris W

Nora Patel: privacy note: redact request body. show stable event hash and path. provide "view raw (requires IAM)" if someone has permission. also display which sampling policy was active at trigger time.

Chris Wang: api contract suggestion: return computed_reason, raw_reasons array, sampling_meta. example payload (as string here): {\"computed_reason\":\"503_spike\",\"raw_reasons\":[{\"code\":503,\"count\":98},{\"code\":\"timeout\",\"count\":24}],\"sampled_fraction\":0.01,\"sampled_ids\":[\"evt_abc123\",\"evt_def456\"]}

Maria Gomez: ux microcopy: \"Automatically fell back to lower-latency model due to elevated 503 rate — 1% of requests sampled.\" concise and human-friendly.

Alex Kim: engineering Qs for the RFC: 1) store raw_reasons summary at write-time or compute on-read? 2) sampling_metadata contract: seed + fraction + deterministic id scheme?

Chris Wang: propose compute-on-write summary (counts) and keep sampled event pointers for 30d. keeps queries fast, bounded storage. include sampling_seed and sampling_policy_id in sampling_meta.

Nora Patel: ui affordance: small "why" pill that on hover reveals a breakdown and link to expand full list. include an info icon explaining sampling/retention.

Alex Kim: privacy checklist to include in RFC: redaction rules, default retention 30d for sampled events, IAM gating for raw view, KMS pointer for any decrypted payloads.

Chris Wang: i'll prototype schema and endpoint in a branch and add unit tests for redaction + sampling_meta correctness.

Nora Patel: i'll mock compact card + expanded drawer in Figma and attach to RFC.

Maria Gomez: also add a small telemetry legend explaining sample fraction semantics (random vs head-based sampling) and link to our sampling docs.

Alex Kim: next steps: @Chris open draft PR for audit schema, @Nora attach mocks to the RFC, i'll file the tiny RFC and add to the design sprint board. thanks all :party_parrot:
